title: Binance Will List Biconomy (BICO)
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list  Biconomy (BICO)  and will open trading for  BICO/BTC ,  BICO/BUSD , and  BICO/USDT  trading pairs at 2021-12-09 06:00 (UTC). Users can now start depositing  BICO  in preparation for trading Withdrawals for BICO will open at 2021-12-10 06:00 (UTC) Note: The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status on the withdrawal page What is Biconomy (BICO)? Biconomy offers a plug-and-play relayer infrastructure to developers. BICO is its native governance token that can be staked to receive rewards. BICO Listing Fee: 0 BNB.
